name: Smb Hr Compliance Pack
description: Generate state-compliant HR documents for small and mid-size businesses. Five production-ready generators covering Offer Letter, Employee Handbook, Performance Improvement Plan, Termination Package (checklist + letter + paycheck guide), and 90-Day Onboarding Checklist. State-aware language (at-will, final-paycheck rules, leave laws) reduces legal risk for SMBs without an in-house HR team. Built for founders, office managers, and HR consultants who need defensible employment documents in minutes instead of days.
longDescription:
Ships **5 commands**.

- **Commands** (5): `handbook`, `offer-letter`, `onboarding`, `pip`, `termination`

Installs with `claude plugin install smb-hr-compliance-pack@claude-community` from `DonteWong/claude-plugins-official` (`external_plugins/smb-hr-compliance-pack`).

A comprehensive Claude Code plugin that generates state-compliant HR documents for small and mid-size businesses. Create professional, legally defensible employment documents in minutes.
